params.prompt: [Static shot] Full-body right-facing profile of this exact technician. Both boots stay planted and the body remains standing. The silver open-end wrench with its yellow handle stays attached vertically to the belt, motionless for the entire shot. He promptly reaches into a separate dark tablet pouch behind his hip and pulls out a flat rectangular graphite tablet, holds it in both gloved hands in front of his chest with its screen facing himself, looks down slightly to read it and taps the screen once. He returns the same rectangular tablet to its pouch and relaxes into the original standing pose. The tablet is broad and rectangular from the moment it leaves the pouch. Preserve the exact slim proportions, brown hair, goggles, moustache, matte charcoal suit, muted yellow patches and backpack. Restrained head movement; continuous natural arm motion. Fixed camera, full body always visible, plain solid green background. No tool or prop transformation. No wrench in either hand. No stepping, turning, kneeling or blowtorch. Constant neutral diffuse lighting and white balance throughout every frame. Preserve the reference colors continuously, with no yellow, green or purple color flashes, changing illumination or animated screen light.
